newsitem.title: USA: US corp bonds mixed amid Treasury, stock weakness.
newsitem.headline: US corp bonds mixed amid Treasury, stock weakness.

text.p: Weakness in the Treasury and stock markets on Thursday had a mixed effect on the U.S. corporate bond market on Wednesday, traders said.

Junk bond trading activity picked up on Wednesday from earlier in the week. Prices opened firmer but eventually followed the Treasury and stock markets lower in the afternoon, traders said. Junk bonds ended the day 1/8 to 1/4 point weaker.
But Treasury volatility dampened trading in the high-grade market. Nevertheless, traders said the market was firm thoughout the day, with prices ending unchanged to slightly better.
"The market in triple-B's continues to be better," said one trader. "People are still looking for yield and positive credit stories."

Traders said Tele-Communications Inc is benefitting from such sentiment. The cable company's 30-year bonds tightened to 169 basis points over Treasuries from a 175 bid spread on Wednesday. Spreads have tightened 25-30 basis points since TCI released strong earnings last week, traders said.
Returning to the junk bond market, Grand Union Co 12 percent senior notes dropped two points on news Joseph McCaig, the company's chief executive officer, resigned.
